svg.title: Chatham VIII: Red Yellow
svg.desc: Interpretive vector after actual visual inspection. Approximate contours and vivid screen colors. Chatham VIII identified by EK459 caption; red horizontal upper panel and narrow yellow lower-left panel. Approximate view proportions, no inferred physical dimensions.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-chatham-series/; inspected 2026-10-27; interpretive study, not a facsimile.
